theorems.name: Submission.frt_weq_piece_restrict_eq_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μHE[n] A ≠ ∞ → NullMeasurableSet A μHE[n] → (∀ x ∈ A, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ Z ⊆ A, μHE[n] Z = 0 → μ Z = 0) → (∀ Z ⊆ A, μ Z = 0 → μHE[n] Z = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A, HasDensity n ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict A) x 1) → ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ (B ∩ A) = ∫⁻ x in B ∩ A, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
